item.text:
Gap status
- Deliberate falsehood/correction: partly resolved. I found an independent 2022 fact-check showing the viral three-term screenshots were doctored and that Jokowi had not indicated he would serve beyond the constitutional limit.
- Conflicts of interest, procurement favoritism, and family/business benefit: partly resolved on transparency and anti-conflict controls, but not resolved on a direct Jokowi-specific self-dealing finding.
- Direct family/business profit from office: not recoverable from the 2022 material I found. I did not locate a 2022 audit, court filing, or investigative finding tying Jokowi or close family to a concrete office-linked financial benefit.

New evidence
- Doctored screenshots on third-term claim were fake; AFP also states Jokowi had not indicated any plan to extend beyond two terms as of April 19, 2022. This is useful as independent corroboration for his public stance, not as proof of broader honesty.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Doctored news reports mislead on likelihood of third term for Indonesian president","publisher":"AFP Fact Check","publication_date":"2022-04-19","url":"https://factcheck.afp.com/doc.afp.com.32872H7","claim":"The screenshots circulating online were doctored, and as of April 19, 2022 Jokowi had not indicated he planned to serve beyond the constitutional two-term limit.","locator":"lines 60-61 and 90-96","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"AFP independently verified the screenshots and distinguished them from genuine articles; the claim is narrow and well-specified.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Exact 2022 fit.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect but relevant: it corroborates Jokowi’s public posture on term limits, while not proving broader personal integrity.","contrary_evidence":["This does not prove Jokowi never misstated other matters; it only rebuts one fabricated claim about him."],"lenses":["7B.1","7B.2","7B.8"]}

- Jokowi’s wealth disclosure was publicly filed on February 24, 2022, and the Kompas report reproduces the reported total and composition of assets from the KPK LHKPN data.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Rincian Harta Kekayaan Presiden Jokowi yang Naik Rp 7,8 Miliar Selama 2021","publisher":"Kompas.com","publication_date":"2022-04-24","url":"https://www.kompas.com/wiken/read/2022/04/24/060000981/rincian-harta-kekayaan-presiden-jokowi-yang-naik-rp-7-8-miliar-selama-2021?page=all","claim":"Jokowi filed his LHKPN on February 24, 2022, and the report states his total wealth for 2021 rose to Rp 71.47 billion, with assets mainly in land and buildings, vehicles, other movable assets, and cash equivalents.","locator":"lines 146-158","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"The article directly reports the filing date and contents from the KPK LHKPN data; it is useful for public disclosure, though it is still secondary reporting.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Exact 2022 fit.","ruler_attribution":"Directly attributable to Jokowi’s own mandated disclosure; it supports transparency but does not establish absence of conflicts by itself.","contrary_evidence":["Self-reported disclosure is not an independent clean-bill finding and does not rule out undisclosed conflicts."],"lenses":["7B.3","7B.4","7B.6","7B.10"]}

- Jokowi ordered BPKP/APIP to discipline government, SOE, and regional spending toward domestic products, remove imported products that can be made locally from the e-catalogue, and enforce the spending target. This is concrete anti-favoritism/procurement-control action.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"President Jokowi Tells BPKP, APIP to Enforce Discipline over Domestic Product Spending","publisher":"Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia","publication_date":"2022-06-14","url":"https://setkab.go.id/en/president-jokowi-tells-bpkp-apip-to-enforce-discipline-over-domestic-product-spending/","claim":"Jokowi ordered BPKP and APIP to discipline government, SOE, and regional-entity spending, remove importable products from the e-catalogue, and enforce local-product spending targets.","locator":"lines 37-50","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Primary official record of a presidential directive with specific procurement-enforcement instructions.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Exact 2022 fit.","ruler_attribution":"Directly attributable to Jokowi as the issuing authority for the directive.","contrary_evidence":["This is an anti-favoritism control, not proof that favoritism or procurement abuse was absent."],"lenses":["7B.3","7B.5","7B.9"]}

Search and rejection summary
- I checked AFP fact-check material, KPK/LHKPN transparency material, Kompas reporting on Jokowi’s filed asset declaration, and presidential-secretariat records on spending discipline.
- I rejected out-of-period material on 2024 SOE-family appointments and other post-2022 nepotism stories because they do not fit the target year.
- I rejected generic corruption or SOE-governance studies when they lacked a Jokowi-specific 2022 personal nexus.
- I did not find a 2022 court, audit, or investigative finding that directly established Jokowi-family business benefit or procurement self-dealing.
- I hit a partial access limit on some commercial/local pages, but the key usable sources above were accessible; the remaining search paths were mostly non-productive because they produced only general transparency rules or commentary.

Remaining gaps
- Direct Jokowi-specific evidence of family/business profit from office remains not recoverable from the 2022 record I found.
- Direct procurement-favoritism evidence tied to Jokowi personally is still thin; the available material mainly shows anti-conflict directives rather than verified abuse.
- The evidence on deliberate falsehood is only partial: it confirms one false rumor was fabricated, but it does not establish a broad pattern of truthful correction or dishonesty.
- If you want, the only useful next search would be a very narrow pass through 2022 KPK, BPK, and major investigative reporting for any Jokowi-linked asset, procurement, or family-benefit finding.
